item.title: Tandem 1.0.13
item.description: - Connect your Claude plan without Terminal: Install Claude Code and Sign in with Claude are in Set up your desk. - Company filings wait in your inbox and no longer ring your phone, unless you turn them on. - Emergency stop, routines, phone approval and AI settings show names, not internal ids. - The assistant reads replies that contain line breaks. - The assistant never places real-money orders on its own. It proposes them, and you confirm. - A Telegram approval message now shows the order it approves. - Your phone can reach the desk only after pairing, even from inside your Tailscale network. - The assistant has room for ordinary questions, shows your question beside its reply, and says plainly why when it can't answer. - A calmer, plainer desk: practice and real money in the same words everywhere, one-line empty states, neutral colours except for money, and a value chart that shows gain since you started. - On a phone: bigger buttons, no zoom when you type, and the stop notice and Ask AI fit the screen. - Stop new trades works from a paired phone.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.12
item.description: - Every page has a new, calmer layout. - Every order, AI proposal and access renewal is confirmed in one Review sheet, showing your account before and after. - Ask AI is a bar at the bottom of each page. It suggests; you confirm. - Your phone rings less: no alerts for recoveries or brief order checks, and at most 4 routine alerts an hour. - Tandem is smaller: the download is about 40 MB lighter. - Orders to review, the breaker and approvals always come through, whatever the hourly limit. - After an emergency stop, Turn new trades back on resumes only what the stop stopped. - Emergency stop results read in words, such as "SPY: closed". - A cancelled order's receipt says so, and a refused cancel says nothing was sent. - When Webull is busy, Tandem says nothing was sent and to try again in a minute. - A routine that fails once tries again quietly; your phone rings if it fails twice in a row. - Markets shows the Prediction and Crypto research tabs only on desks that run research. - The assistant and setup screens name accounts and strategies plainly, not by internal ids.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.11
item.description: World Monitor on every desk, and fixes: Overview counts one account set, preset caps stay within account limits, presets and plans fit your accounts, the practice week ends correctly, setup choices saved on the desk, terms show once, no internal ids, research cards only when they ran, clearer Kalshi busy message, unsaved demo keys deleted at start, background data updates in the installed app.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.10
item.description: Accounts shows AI mode, recent orders and money in and out. Overview returns show income. Kalshi and Polymarket US recent orders and fill fees. A price alert column on the watchlist.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.9
item.description: New layout for Overview, Markets, Accounts, Strategies and Settings with a light theme. Real-money orders from an AI app are confirmed in the desk; automatic mode takes two steps. A Stop button on the phone. Pages appear at once. The install guide matches the notarized app.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.8
item.description: One app for everyone, safer setup limits, live venue order fixes and fresh-install fixes.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.7
item.description: Since you last looked, sample-data tour, trading word definitions, monthly deposit reminder, weekly summary alert, and fixes.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.6
item.description: Setup ends with a starting plan. Limit presets on the Limits step. A Fund your accounts guide. Viewing: Practice | Real. One-line Desk health.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.5
item.description: - Every page lists only the accounts you connected. - When an order is held or refused, the desk says why in a plain sentence. - If the Mac was asleep at 4:15 pm, the daily account record is taken when it wakes, marked as late. - If the desk stops while Tandem is open, the menu bar says Desk stopped and offers Restart desk. - If Tandem cannot copy your data before an update, it does not start and says what to do. Nothing is changed. - A Webull account connected for practice shows Done (paper) in setup while live waits for Webull's approval. - Routines show plain names, and the monthly venue checks say they are checked daily and run once a month. - The guides match the app, and a new Remove Tandem guide is in Help. - Phone alerts use the help contact as their sender contact. - The app is smaller: research parts you never use are no longer included.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.4
item.description: - Settings is one page with one menu on the left. - Adding an account starts with four venue cards; you choose practice or real in the same steps. - A short terms screen shows once. After that, one slim line reminds you until you accept. - Presets open as a catalog of cards. - The AI assistant page is the chat, with the account chosen next to the message box. - Webull crypto is found on your saved Webull connection. - Your return no longer goes blank after the Mac was off for a few days. It counts across the gap and says how many days were not recorded. - A monthly statement starts at the last close before the 1st of its month. - The tax export lists crypto as crypto, keeps its decimals, and does not run the wash-sale estimate on it. - Settings, About lists one notice for the dashboard's open-source libraries and says where the Python licences are.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.3
item.description: Practice | Real switch at the top. Real money can be turned on any time with Review, then Confirm. Daily database backup on this Mac. Start at login for new installs. Fixes: Polymarket US account drawer, slow start, red zero, Check for Updates in the menu bar icon.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.2
item.description: Faster pages; a fresh install sets itself up; Kalshi practice orders work; prices for Kalshi and crypto; 8-K filing alerts; wash-sale estimates and a tax-loss list; licences in About.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.1
item.description: Closing the window keeps Tandem running in the menu bar, with no Dock icon. You choose whether this Mac stays awake while the desk runs (Settings, This Mac). With it off, the Mac sleeps as usual and the desk checks your accounts again when it wakes. Quit Tandem from the menu bar and it stays off until you open it again.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.0
item.description: First release of Tandem. Drag it to Applications to install. Phone alerts set up with a QR code, an optional AI app, Remove Tandem in Settings, What's new after each update, and automatic updates from now on.
